topic: Beyoncé's Record-Breaking Grammy Night, in 30 Seconds

sentences.text: In one night, Beyoncé became the most-awarded artist in Grammy history.
Her fourth win was best dance and electronic music album, for Renaissance.
On stage she said she was just trying to receive the night.
That made thirty-two Grammys in her career.
More than any other artist in the awards' history.
